'''Pale Broth''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].  

'''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - Pale Broth  sells for {{Price|150}} and 2 [[White Algae]] sell for {{Price|50}}.

A [[Ghostfish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 3 Pale Broth when the population of the pond reaches 9.
